verdict.rationale: Skills are plain SKILL.md markdown files in per-skill folders (review/, qa/, ship/, cso/, etc.). Dev mode symlinks a repo checkout straight into .claude/skills/, and a community member describes the install model as git-clone-and-copy. Portability to other harnesses is backed by a host system covering Claude, Codex, Factory, Kiro, OpenCode, Cursor and others, where adding a new host takes one config file. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that skills can be copied by hand to another harness without the gstack generator, clarity on whether host exports alter the markdown, and independent hands-on confirmation of cross-harness portability.
